summary_zh: 题面、例子和参考解答都对，没有改。只改了来源说明：原文说网上那份清单“只用一行”列出了这道题，实际是三行要点；另外去掉了一个像文件名的项目编号，并补全了一处删掉名字后留下的空缺。

issues.problem_zh: 原文写“网上一份整理清单 也只用一行列出了‘延迟返现、余额历史、支出排行’”：中间有一处删掉名字后留下的空缺，读不通；而且那份清单把“银行账本”列在在线测评题下面，写了三行要点（开户、存款和转账；24 小时后到账的返现；余额历史和支出排行），不是一行。另外“mock-bank-4”是那个练习集里的文件编号，用户看不懂。
issues.change_zh: 改成“网上一份 Anthropic 面试整理清单把‘银行账本’列为在线测评题，也只有三行要点（……），没有题面”；“Fellowship Trainer 的 mock-bank-4”改成“Fellowship Trainer 里的银行四关模拟题”；“检查代码里”改成“本页的验证代码里”，和页面上的标题一致。其余说法（两个练习集都自称模拟题、LibreSignal 第 2 关和第 4 关例子表数字对不上、两份参考实现对被合并账户的历史余额处理不同）都核对过，属实，没有改。

checked: ran page and with --hash-seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED 0 and 1), before and after the edit: all pass

wrote my own implementation of all four levels from the statement only (union-find style owner pointers, unsorted pending list, linear history scan) before reading the reference; it reproduces every statement example in all four levels, and so does the page reference

compared my implementation with the page reference on 7,000 random operation sequences (5,000 of 60 ops, 2,000 of 200 ops) with timestamps placed exactly on, 1 ms before and 1 ms after cashback due times and time_at placed on creation, merge and due times +-1; ids reused after merge, self-transfer, self-merge, unknown ids, zero amounts, overdrafts, unknown payment ids: 0 mismatches
checked the random comparison has teeth: mutated references (settle with <, cashback booked at call time, pending cashback not redirected on merge, get_balance only for live ids) are each caught

ran hand-built edge cases on both implementations: chain merge with cashback landing in the final owner, merge exactly at a due time, an id merged away and reopened twice with old payments invisible to the new account, zero-amount pay and transfer

looked for rules the statement leaves open (cashback exactly at the due time, cashback due exactly at a merge, time_at equal to creation/merge time, reopened ids, payment ownership after chained merges, tie order in top_spenders): each is either stated or has no observable effect

read the LibreSignal bank level 2 and level 4 statements: confirmed the level 2 table's transfer(10, account1, account2, 2500) is impossible (account1 holds 1000) and the first level 4 table's 1500 / 3000 / 3906 do not follow from its rules (1000 / 3500 / 3610); checked the page's transcription of the LibreSignal unit tests and its marked timestamp fixes against the source test file

read the LibreSignal and Fellowship Trainer reference solutions: LibreSignal returns None unless the id exists now and mixes both accounts' snapshots; the trainer replays the merged transaction logs and redirects a merged-away id to the surviving account; matches the origin line and the follow-up bullet
checked the online list: an Anthropic prep gist lists 'Bank Ledger' under CodeSignal OA questions with three bullet points and no statement
checked the page's claim about 750/1000 and 800/1000 against the Anthropic process page

code_run.notes: Page passes as written, also under PYTHONHASHSEED 0 and 1. Only meta.yaml was edited; README.zh.md is unchanged.

env_evidence: 按顺序实现下面四关：只有前一关的测试全部通过，下一关的测试才会运行；每一关都在同一个 `Bank` 类上继续加方法，不是另起一个类。
